_comment: Single source of truth for cross-environment URLs. Edit ONLY here. folddb_profile/build.rs reads this at compile time and emits Rust constants in OUT_DIR. DO NOT hardcode any gateway hostnames anywhere else; scripts/lints/lint-no-hardcoded-urls.sh enforces this in CI. release_log_url is the base URL of the verifier's release log; release_log_keys lists its Ed25519 signing keys as base64 raw 32-byte public keys. An empty key list makes a node refuse every app install.
